description: Clean, minimal internal web app for managing branch loan forms, applications, and rate sheets with version control and AI assistant capabilities.

tech_stack.frontend: Next.js (App Router) + Tailwind CSS + Lucide Icons
tech_stack.database_schema: PostgreSQL / Supabase / Google Sheets (via Service Account)

components: Top Global Search Bar with Natural Language support
Most Frequently Used Docs (Top 5 Quick Access Pins)
Document Cards with clear Active status badges and download CTA
Dropzone for uploading or scanning documents to verify version

รถเพื่อการเกษตร (รถไถ / รถเกี่ยว)
โฉนดที่ดิน (ขายฝาก / จำนอง / จำนำที่ดิน)

โปรโมชันและแคมเปญส่งเสริมการขาย
เกณฑ์ราคากลางประเมินยานพาหนะ

version_check.task: Inspect uploaded files against database active versions.
version_check.rule: If the user uploads or checks a file with an older date/version code, warn immediately and provide the direct active download link.

change_summary.task: Compare new version against previous version.
change_summary.output_format: 2-3 short Thai bullet points explaining what clauses, rates, or sections changed.

semantic_search.task: Map user conversational queries (e.g., 'ลูกค้าจำนำรถไถต้องใช้เอกสารอะไรบ้าง') to recommended document bundles.
semantic_search.output: Return array of matching document IDs with Active status.

auto_tagging.task: Perform OCR on uploaded PDF/Image to auto-populate title, category, effective date, and version.

implementation_tasks: Step 1: Setup Next.js Tailwind project scaffold with mobile/tablet responsive layout.
Step 2: Create mock data store based on the 5 document categories and schema.
Step 3: Build Dashboard UI with search bar, Top 5 most used pins, and category filters.
Step 4: Implement document upload modal with drag-and-drop file verification.
Step 5: Integrate Gemini API route for semantic search, changelog summarization, and version checking.
